TRIGGERED_ABILITY.RESOLUTION_TIME_ACTION: local effectController = EffectController() effectController:BeginNewMultipleChoice() effectController:AddMultipleChoiceAnswer( "CARD_QUERY_UNLEASH" ) effectController:AddMultipleChoiceAnswer( "CARD_QUERY_DO_NOT_UNLEASH" ) effectController:AskMultipleChoiceQuestion( "CARD_QUERY_QUESTION_DO_YOU_WANT_TO_UNLEASH", TriggerObject() )
if EffectSource() ~= nil then local answer = EffectController():GetMultipleChoiceResult() if answer == 0 then EffectSource():AddCounters( MTG():PlusOnePlusOneCounters(), 1) end end

STATIC_ABILITY.CONTINUOUS_ACTION: if EffectSource() ~= nil then if EffectSource():CountCounters(MTG():PlusOnePlusOneCounters()) >= 1 then local characteristics = EffectSource():GetCurrentCharacteristics() characteristics:Bool_Set( CHARACTERISTIC_CANT_BLOCK, 1 ) end end
